title: hasseanthus variegatus var. blochmaniae
intro: Hasseanthus variegatus var. blochmaniae, commonly known as Island Kingcup or Blochmania, is a flowering plant species in the family Compositae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Blochmania include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Blochmania include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
